serverUrl.title: Governance server URL
serverUrl.description: Base URL of the CloudFuze AI-Governance server, e.g. https://agentgovernence.cftools.live

enrollSecret.title: Enrollment secret
enrollSecret.description: Shared secret used to enroll this browser with the governance server. Provisioned by IT; never shown to the user.

userEmail.title: User email (optional)
userEmail.description: Override identity for attribution. Normally left empty so the desktop agent's identity beacon supplies the real user automatically.

employeeEmail.title: Employee email (optional)
employeeEmail.description: Optional employee directory email attached at enrollment.

computerName.title: Computer name (optional)
computerName.description: Override machine name. Normally left empty so the desktop agent's identity beacon supplies it automatically.
